highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and updates the bundled renderer to Skia m152.
highlights_body: The release adds asynchronous pixel reads and a Vulkan Silk.NET package, while improving native lifetime safety, data handling, and HarfBuzz shaping performance.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent upstream m151 and m152 fixes.
Exposes the Graphite backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn integrations.
SKImage and SKSurface can now request pixel data asynchronously through backend-neutral APIs.
Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for applications using Silk.NET Vulkan bindings.
Keeps backing pixel sources alive for SKPixmap subset and With operations, preventing use-after-free failures.
Releases allocated pixel buffers when raster image creation fails.

bullets.lead: Uniform and stream resources released correctly
bullets.detail: Disposes replaced runtime-effect uniform buffers and non-memory-backed streams converted to HarfBuzz blobs.
Uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server.
Packages native symbols for Apple targets to improve native diagnostics.

bullets.lead: Data and tag operations allocate less
bullets.detail: Avoids an extra buffer copy when saving SKData and removes unnecessary allocations from tag and encoded-text conversion paths.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Nano Server font support through FreeType
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced Skia m152, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and the Vulkan Silk.NET package.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 completed native packaging work and runtime lifetime, performance, and engine servicing fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzz shaping performance by avoiding an unnecessary defensive feature-array copy and fixes stream cleanup during blob conversion.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 delivers Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and the Skia m152 engine.
v4.152.0.body: The stable release also includes native lifetime, data-handling, and shaping performance improvements.
